title: Articles: A, An, The
explanation: Articles are determiners that come before nouns. 'A/An' (indefinite) = one of many, first mention, non-specific. Use 'a' before consonant sounds, 'an' before vowel sounds. 'The' (definite) = specific, already mentioned, unique things, superlatives. No article = general plurals, abstract concepts, proper nouns.
examples: I saw a dog in the park. (first mention, any dog)
The dog was brown. (now we know which dog)
She is an engineer. (profession, vowel sound)
The sun rises in the east. (unique thing)
I love music. (abstract concept, no article)

exercises.question: Can you pass me ___ salt? (the salt on the table)
